snippet.title: Anima Keeper - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the brutal world of Anima Keeper and get a look at gameplay in this trailer for the upcoming action RPG. Time is always running out in Anima Keeper. Your main goal is to survive before the collapse comes. Marauders, mystical creatures, mutated monsters with deformed souls - they all want you dead. Do whatever it takes to gather treasures and hide in a shelter before the final wave of collapse. Anima Keeper will be available on PC.
